articles.title: Obra Blanca 2026 brought together more than 23,000 industry professionals in its seventh edition
articles.summary: Direct contact with a material allows one to appreciate textures, compare finishes, and observe how its appearance changes under different lighting conditions. At an exhibition, these possibilities are complemented by exchanges with manufacturers and professionals, helping to understand applications and resolve questions about their use. This relationship between material exploration and architectural practice was one of the central pillars of the seventh edition of Obra Blanca, which drew more than 23,000 professionals to Expo Santa Fe in Mexico City.

articles.title: Inhabiting as Inquiry: Threads from the 20th Buenos Aires International Architecture Biennial
articles.summary: Inhabiting a space involves multiple economic, social, cultural, geographic, political, and environmental factors. Beyond these considerations, however, it engages with processes, boundaries, and possibilities that have repeatedly become subjects of architectural inquiry. "We are builders of a society," declared Solano Benitez during his lecture titled The Place of Architecture at the Buenos Aires International Architecture Biennial. Through a series of international lectures, exhibitions across different locations in the city, and activities open to all generations, the 20th Buenos Aires Inte

articles.title: House between Gardens / Studio BHD
articles.summary: Set within Val de Vie Estate in the Paarl Winelands, House Between Gardens is conceived as a contemporary family home shaped by landscape, climate and the rhythms of everyday living. The architecture reinterprets the Cape vernacular H-plan to create a series of interconnected internal and external spaces, allowing the house to sit not simply alongside its landscape, but between and within a collection of gardens.

articles.title: Nazuna Hakone Miyanoshita Hotel / STUDIO ALUC
articles.summary: Nazuna Hakone Miyanoshita is a newly opened ryokan in Hakone by Nazuna, a brand originally established in Kyoto. We were responsible for the design of its refurbishment. While Nazuna has traditionally reinterpreted Kyoto culture through the contemporary re-editing of wooden machiya townhouses, this project required the expression of Kyoto-like qualities within the constraints of a reinforced concrete (RC) structure in Hakone.

articles.title: UMG sede Antigua Guatemala / Atelier oficina de Arquitectura
articles.summary: The UMG Campus in Antigua Guatemala represents a critical case study in bridging traditional colonial architecture with massive institutional scale. Developed by ATELIER Oficina de Arquitectura, the primary challenge of this project was adapting a small-scale colonial design to a large-scale complex. We understood early in the planning phase that simply replicating historical facades is insufficient without considering the context and the diverse needs of a student complex.

articles.title: Haras Larissa Residence / Ricardo Gusmão Arquitetos
articles.summary: Located in the Haras Larissa gated community, near São Paulo, the house was conceived as a retreat from the city in direct contact with the rural landscape.

articles.title: Cibeles House / Taller Síntesis
articles.summary: The Cibeles House is located in the municipality of La Ceja , a region characterized by open landscapes, gentle topography, and a strong presence of native vegetation. This natural setting not only frames the project but also defines its starting point: conceiving a home that respects the site, reduces its footprint, and allows the landscape to maintain its continuity.

articles.title: Claranet Portugal Headquarters / PROMONTORIO
articles.summary: Claranet is an IT company providing network hosting and managed application services (Hybrid Cloud Hosting) to corporate clients across Europe and Brazil. The practice was invited to design its Portuguese headquarters on the site of a former military depot, itself built on the grounds of the 17th-century Grilas Sisters' convent. The convent survived the 1755 earthquake but not the 1834 extinction of the religious orders. It became state property and in 1897, was converted into military warehouses. articles.title: Wowhaus' Dichroic Glass "Inspire" Sculpture

Commissioned by the San Ramon Public Library, the stainless steel structure mimics a book, with the pages made of dichroic glass; this is glass that has multiple coatings on it, with each layer tuned to reflect some colors of light while letting others pass through. The result is that the colors on each pane appear to shift as you walk around it.
